systemd Service Generator

Generate a systemd unit file — ExecStart, user, restart policy, environment and install target.

Install: save to /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service, then systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now myapp

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the description and ExecStart command.
  2. Set the user, working directory and restart policy.
  3. Add environment variables (one KEY=value per line).
  4. Copy the unit file or download myapp.service.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where does the file go?

Save as /etc/systemd/system/<name>.service, then run: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now <name>.

Which restart policy should I use?

on-failure restarts only on crashes; always restarts even after clean exits.

How are environment variables formatted?

One KEY=value per line — values with spaces are quoted automatically.

What does WantedBy do?

WantedBy=multi-user.target makes the service start on boot when enabled.
